core_obligations: The authors translate reconstruction and secrecy into Fourier constraints, construct a winning mixed strategy for a zero-sum game from any sharing scheme, and derive a contradiction at the ramp-specific payoff threshold. Threshold schemes, combined bounds and relaxation-tightness examples are context, not additional counts.
